description: Select a piece of text inside an element's value, or put the caret right before/after it. text is the exact substring; text_before / text_after (the text right next to it) tell repeated occurrences apart. mode: "select" (default), "caret_before", "caret_after". Useful before write_text to replace or insert at a precise spot. Requires a prior observe_app for this app in this session. Call observe_app afterwards to verify the result.

app.description: Target app: its name as listed by find_apps, its id (bundle id / executable name), or its absolute path.

element.description: Element number: the #number from the latest observe_app output for this app.

mode.description: "select" selects it (default); "caret_before" / "caret_after" put the caret there.

text.description: Exact text to find in the element's value.

text_after.description: Text right after the occurrence (tells repeats apart).

text_before.description: Text right before the occurrence (tells repeats apart).

name: pick_text
title: Select text
